'''Amelie''' was a [[Millicreep/Legends|Millicreep]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that served the [[Umbaran militia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was captured during the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]] and re-programmed to be the companion of a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]].
